name: Paper
description: Paper Edge is the default face of the system: warm paper, ink, and a hard edge. Flat 2.0 stays one switch away. / Project-X promo site.

name: The Desk
description: The home desk opens on the work itself. Answer sheets, exams, scores and accounts share one paper surface, and the latest marked paper is one step away. / Live system.

name: Sheets
description: Answer sheets are drawn in the browser: choice blocks, blanks, pictures, notes and subject templates, then exported as a PDF for the printer. / Promo site, modules.

name: The Exam
description: One exam can be a morning test, open to the teachers who need it, or a formal paper with a tighter lock. The office can change that mode later. / Promo site, modules.

name: The Scan
description: The Windows desk scans through TWAIN, or takes a folder of images. Progress stays visible, a batch can be cancelled, and a stuck minute is a fault, not a result. / Promo site, the scan.

name: Marking
description: Filled boxes are read by the recognition engine. Written answers are cut into blocks for two or three markers, and a wide gap goes to arbitration. The teacher still marks the handwriting. / Promo site, marking.

name: The Record
description: Class rank, spread, difficulty and discrimination stay with the paper. A weak knowledge point can be named. The score itself remains the school record. / Promo site, scores.

name: Two Skins
description: Before the first login the school chooses a skin. Paper Edge is the print face. Flat 2.0 is the other. The choice is kept on the account. / Promo site, the two previews.

name: Calendar
description: Exams sit on the days they happen. A group of papers can share a grade. The office sees the term before it sees another table. / Promo site, calendar.

name: The Week
description: The weekly audit counts the papers, compares classes, and lists the weak items. A week can be published, and recent weeks can be filled in. / Promo site, weekly audit.

name: Reading
description: A model can read the paper and name a weak point. It does not mark the written answer. The model can be changed, or turned off. / Promo site, AI notes.

name: On Site
description: The promo site argues against a rented marking service: the scores sit on the school server, a template can be changed in the room, and the people who keep it are already there. / Promo site, comparison.

name: The Roles
description: The office opens an exam. A marker takes the next paper. A tutor reads the class. A student sees only their own result. The lock is the point. / Promo site, roles.

name: Open
description: Project-X is published under GPL-3.0 by the IT center of Dalian No.5 Middle School. The promo site is the front door. The repository is the work. / Main repository.
